problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y={7}^{x}+4?$
worked_solution:
First, we plot the graph of $y={7}^{x}:$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13930907/assets/cd8226319b26b3fef6db6e98efc187b1c474c91bc0252e424151791fda373b95.png)

To sketch the graph of $y={7}^{x}+4,$ we take the graph of $y={7}^{x}$ and shift it $4$ units up. The $y$-intercept moves from $(0,1)$ to $(0,5),$ and the horizontal asymptote moves from $y=0$ to $y=4.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13930907/assets/85cc1403ab74e2df97669a7c3363d1abddf6d093c358e888a69b655f1ca7450a.png)
